### Red team · Reply

Event: `7e71c03c66447f96fbe2459900bff1bf` · 2026-09-25T22:38:02Z

> B1 (P2, blocking: I-DMA is the plan's acceptance evidence). The ghost check that a device can no longer write a frame gives up too early. When one process dies, Ghost::dma_reset(d) (ghost.rs, called from kernel.rs dma_release) clears device d from the armed set of EVERY frame. That includes frames held by a live co-holder that still has d mapped, and that co-holder can program d again after the reset. So if B's own death later fails to reset d, I-DMA misses it.
> 
> Evidence. Scratch worktree /tmp/k5b-red1 at e72d63275, now removed. The test used Boot::default plus one more resets=always DMA device (dev 7).
> 1. B holds a dma_alloc frame fB through dev 7 and map_device's DMA (dev 2). armed[fB] = {7, 2}.
> 2. A, holding DMA, map_device's it and exits. dev 2 resets, and armed[fB] = {7}, while B is still alive with dev 2 mapped.
> 
> Planted a kernel bug: a confirmed reset drops that device from every other live process's dma_mapped (the v1 epoch-style reasoning that P1-1 replaced). Then B exits with S = {7}, and fB is pooled without dev 2 ever being reset again. Every per-step Checker check passed. `cargo test --test properties`, all 6 families, 110 s, also PASSED with the plant, and dma_contracts passed 4/4. The default boot's only healthy DMA device is dev 2, so the random search can never build this co-holder shape at all.
> 
> Fix:
> (1) The dying process's reset disarms only the dying process's frames. A live holder's frames stay armed against d until its own dma_release. Equivalently, dma_reset(d) re-arms every other live process's frames that still reach d (dma_arm_current).
> (2) Give the generator or boot a second healthy DMA device, so the co-holder with separate alloc and map devices comes up at random.
> (3) Add a mutation, e.g. K5bResetClearsCoHolderReach (the plant above), caught by kernel_sequence, plus a dma_contracts case for the shape above.
> 
> Checked and fine:
> - The P1-1 rule: confirmed == S, and a quarantined device returns false.
> - The genuine-vs-answer split, which catches K5bFreeBeforeReset and K5bQuarantinedSlotCountsAsReset.
> - unmap keeps a DMA frame, and end_process's second pass pools any unmapped, unquarantined frames.
> - OD2 refusals in process_map, lend and transfer.
> - N1 order in destroy_budget: carve returned, then migration, then the budgets freed.
> - The R6 branches for a quarantined or held-unmapped frame.
> - map_device and dma_alloc refused on a quarantined device.
> 
> P3-1: plan section 5 says I-DMA also checks frames that are "newly handed out". The checker only checks free_frames. That's fine today, because dma_alloc takes never-used frames and no step frees and reallocates. Either say so in VALIDATION.md or trim the plan wording.
> 
> P3-2: in destroy_budget with no parent, frames.remove leaves ghost.armed entries behind. This is harmless (the pool check keys on free_frames), but it's cruft.

### Red team · Reply

Event: `6cecbcd8779462a0713f6c6a8e19d86c` · 2026-09-25T23:06:42Z

> Round 2 (red), fix 2bb280d8b: MERGE. B1 is fixed and P3-1 and P3-2 are addressed.
> 
> What changed:
> - Ghost::dma_reset(d, held) now clears d only from the dying holder's frames.
> - K5bResetClearsCoHolderReach is exactly the plant from round 1.
> - A second healthy DMA device (dev 7) makes the co-holder shape reachable, and the generator now spreads DMA devices across children.
> - The OD6 sweep replaces the NotPermitted checks. Since that sweep removes every handle to a quarantined device, map_device and dma_alloc no longer need their own refusal. R10's delivered check treats a quarantined device as destroyed. The co-holder's existing mapping stays, as the accepted Q144 residual, and P1-1 still quarantines everything at its death.
> 
> Evidence, from a scratch worktree at 2bb280d8b (now removed):
> - dma_contracts: 5/5 pass.
> - mutations: 2/2 pass in 63 s, with every K5b mutation caught by kernel_sequence:
>   - FreeBeforeReset seed 22
>   - QuarantinedSlotCountsAsReset seed 171
>   - UnmapFreesDma seed 11
>   - QuarantineChargeDropped seed 28
>   - QuarantinedDeviceUsable seed 29
>   - ResetClearsCoHolderReach seed 677 ('I-DMA: free frame 18 is still armed against {7}')
>
